name: Eagle-style Controls
description: Eagle-like controls: touchpad swipe pans, pinch and wheel zoom, right click rotates and middle click flips/mirrors what you're moving, Eagle-style via placement.
description_full:
Makes the PCB, footprint, schematic and symbol editors handle the mouse and touchpad like Eagle.

- Two-finger touchpad swipe pans in any direction, including diagonally (Windows' one-axis scroll lock is bypassed)
- Pinch zooms, mouse wheel zooms
- Right click rotates the part you're moving or placing instead of opening the context menu (Shift + right click still opens it)
- Middle click flips (PCB) or mirrors (schematic) the part you're moving; otherwise it goes to the next copper layer
- While routing: right click switches the bend direction; middle click opens the through-via layer chooser, middle click steps through layers and left click places the via
- A part that is only selected is left alone

Every behaviour can be changed or turned off in the settings (Tools > External Plugins > Eagle-style controls), with separate PCB and schematic tabs, plus touchpad pan sensitivity and acceleration. Keys follow KiCad's own hotkey settings.

Starts automatically with the PCB editor. Needs KiCad's trackpad scroll layout (Preferences > Mouse and Touchpad > Reset to Trackpad Defaults); the plugin explains this on first start.

Windows only; uses Precision Touchpad raw input.
